data.title: Foundation faces B1m query
data.description: The Be One Foundation is facing scrutiny over allegations that about 1 million baht was transferred from its accounts to personal accounts belonging to its founder, Chalida Phalamat, and her family.

data.title: Fresh crackdown on illegal dumping
data.description: The government has launched a coordinated crackdown on illegal electronic and industrial waste disposal, deploying 50 inspection teams to examine factories while tightening import controls and reviewing penalties for offenders.

data.title: Bridge over dam to link Kalasin districts
data.description: The Department of Rural Roads (DRR) is building a 1.76-kilometre bridge across Lam Pao Reservoir in Kalasin to connect Sahatsakhan and Sam Chai districts, improve transport links and support agricultural trade and tourism.

data.title: Nation slips in rule of law rank
data.description: Thailand fell three places to 80th in the 2026 World Justice Project Rule of Law Index, with corruption and weak law enforcement among its primary concerns.

data.title: Robot used in new heart surgery
data.description: Rajavithi Hospital has become the first hospital under the Ministry of Public Health to perform minimally invasive, multi-vessel coronary artery bypass surgery using robotic assistance.

data.title: Crypto scams cause highest fraud losses, ACSC says
data.description: Cryptocurrency investment scams caused the highest financial losses among online fraud cases reported most recently.

data.title: Govt gets low marks on  drugs, graft
data.description: The Thai Political Index fell slightly to 3.52 points out of 10 in October, down from 3.56 in September, with opposition performance receiving the highest rating and the government's handling of drugs and influential figures scoring the lowest, according to a Suan Dusit Poll survey.

data.title: Expo to boost Udon Thani's profile
data.description: The Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 offers an opportunity to turn the northeastern province into a hub for high-value agriculture, smart farming, wellness products and herbal industries, according to Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat.

data.title: 'Short circuit risk' remains, university says
data.description: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT) has warned flood victims to check their homes for hidden electrical and structural damage, as submerged appliances could cause fires even if they appear to work normally.

data.title: Arsenic levels exceed safe limits at Sai River test sites
data.description: Arsenic levels in the Sai River exceeded safety standards at all monitoring points in the latest survey, prompting Thai authorities to step up water quality checks and seek cooperation with Myanmar and Laos.

data.title: Govt readies B100 weekday travel deal
data.description: The government will offer 100-baht weekday travel vouchers to boost local tourism income, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said on Sunday.

data.title: Anutin invites Thais to invest in Bhutan
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is urging Thai businesses to help develop Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC), a planned economic hub, as Thailand seeks to expand trade and investment ties with the Himalayan kingdom.

data.title: No 'secret deal' for Thaksin
data.description: Pheu Thai Party leader Julapun Amornvivat has firmly denied rumours of a secret political deal exchanging an amnesty for former premier Thaksin Shinawatra for votes of confidence in the upcoming censure debate.

data.title: Israel elections chief says inquiry into irregularities will not undermine result
data.description: JERUSALEM - The head of Israel's Central Elections Committee said on Sunday that an ongoing investigation into alleged foreign funding in the country's recent vote would not call into question its result, noting that so far "suspicions remain suspicions".

data.title: Tens of thousands protest in India's capital against voter roll revision
data.description: NEW DELHI (INDIA) - Tens of thousands joined a protest led by opposition politicians in India's capital on Sunday, renewing demands for the country's election chief to resign over an overhaul of voter lists they say unfairly benefits the ruling party.

data.title: France launches 'attempted murder' probe after petrol bomb attack on security forces
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - France has launched an attempted murder investigation after petrol bombs were thrown at security forces during a weekend protest in Paris, prosecutors told AFP on Sunday.

data.title: Yamaha pulls out of Qatar MotoGP over 'Middle East situation'
data.description: SEPANG (MALAYSIA) - Yamaha said on Sunday it will not participate in next weekend's Qatar MotoGP, citing "the situation in the Middle East".

data.title: Smugglers caught with 32,400 assault rifle cartridges
data.description: TRAT – Authorities seized 32,400 rounds of 7.62mm assault rifle ammunition and arrested four Thais and a Cambodian on a speedboat at the mouth of a canal in this eastern province bordering Cambodia on Sunday morning.

data.title: Myanmar airstrike on Karen damages homes in Thailand
data.description: MAE HONG SON - Blast waves from a Myanmar military airstrike targeting Karen forces near the border damaged at least 17 homes and several public buildings across the Salween River in Thailand's tambon Mae Sam Lap of Sob Moei district, local offiials said.

data.title: Police raid Bangkok shop selling cannabis sweets
data.description: A cannabis shop selling cannabis infused sweets was raided after a couple complained to Bangkok police they passed out after eating some of them.

data.title: Hackers post porn on LED billboards 'to expose security weaknesses'
data.description: Hackers who hijacked LED billboards in Malaysia and posted pornographic videos said they were exposing security weaknesses, not looking to extort victims or distribute ransomware.

data.title: Udon Thani horticultural expo opens
data.description: UDON THANI - The 2026 Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo opened on Sunday with organisers hoping the 2.5-billion-baht event will attract more than 3.6 million visitors during its 134-day run.

data.title: Binance says resuming withdrawals after major hack
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Binance said Sunday that it had resumed withdrawals after a major hack that affected more than $6 billion in funds.

data.title: Suspect ran illegal forex service for buyers of Chinese goods
data.description: Police arrested a Thai man in Bangkok on Saturday for operating an illegal foreign exchange service for people buying goods from China via Chinese payment platforms.

data.title: Divided Bulgaria votes in tense presidential runoff
data.description: SOFIA (BULGARIA) - Bulgarians started voting Sunday in a presidential runoff between two candidates with contrasting visions on the war in Ukraine, following a series of drone attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea.

data.title: Drug shipment seized on Mekong River bank
data.description: NAKHON PHANOM - Border patrol police seized about 1 million methamphetamine pills found in 10 sacks on the bank of the Mekong River in That Phanom district of this north eastern province.

data.title: B10m fighting cock
data.description: BURI RAM - The new owner of a prized fighting cock arrived in Buriram with 10 million baht in cash to seal the deal on Sunday.

data.title: Trump says US looking 'closely' at report Nvidia CEO target of China spy plot
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump voiced on Saturday his support for the "brilliant" head of US chip giant Nvidia, Jensen Huang after a report he was targeted by a Chinese spy plot.

data.title: Spewing US election falsehoods, AI chatbots face scrutiny
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Dispensing misleading voter information, misidentifying candidates, and regurgitating Russian propaganda, AI chatbots are sowing information chaos ahead of the US midterm elections, researchers say.

data.title: 'Seen and heard': Uruguay neighborhood places hopes in pope
data.description: MONTEVIDEO - In one impoverished neighborhood of Uruguay's capital, Catholics and evangelical Christians are unusually harmonious ahead of Pope Leo XIV's visit, with both communities viewing it as an opportunity to shed light on local suffering.

data.title: Pope Leo readies for 'intense' South America homecoming
data.description: VATICAN CITY - Pope Leo XIV is about to embark on one of the most ambitious papal foreign trips in decades, touring Uruguay, Argentina and his adopted homeland Peru, despite recent lung cancer surgery.

data.title: FBI says North Korea behind $6 billion crypto theft from Binance
data.description: NEW YORK - The FBI on Saturday accused North Korea of stealing more than $6 billion in virtual assets from the cryptocurrency exchange Binance in what is thought to be the biggest-ever crypto heist.
